services: db-{{INSTANCE_NAME}}: image: postgres:{{POSTGRES-VERSION}} user: root environment: - POSTGRES_PASSWORD={{POSTGRES_PASSWORD}} - POSTGRES_USER={{POSTGRES_USER}} - POSTGRES_DB=postgres restart: always volumes: - ./postgresql:/var/lib/postgresql/data networks: - db_network
odoo17-{{INSTANCE_NAME}}: image: odoo:{{ODOO-VERSION}} user: root depends_on: - db-{{INSTANCE_NAME}} tty: true command: > -- --db_host=db-{{INSTANCE_NAME}} --db_port={{DB_PORT}} --db_user={{POSTGRES_USER}} --db_password={{POSTGRES_PASSWORD}} environment: - HOST=db-{{INSTANCE_NAME}} - USER={{POSTGRES_USER}} - PASSWORD={{POSTGRES_PASSWORD}} volumes: - ./addons:/mnt/extra-addons - ./etc:/etc/odoo - ./data:/var/lib/odoo restart: always networks: - proxy - db_network labels: - "traefik.enable=true" - "traefik.docker.network=proxy"
# Reglas y Middlewares con nombres únicos por instancia - "traefik.http.routers.{{INSTANCE_NAME}}.rule=Host(`{{INSTANCE_NAME}}.{{BASE_HOSTNAME}}`)" - "traefik.http.routers.{{INSTANCE_NAME}}.service={{INSTANCE_NAME}}" - "traefik.http.routers.{{INSTANCE_NAME}}.entrypoints=https" - "traefik.http.routers.{{INSTANCE_NAME}}.tls=true" - "traefik.http.services.{{INSTANCE_NAME}}.loadbalancer.server.port=8069"
# Redirección HTTP a HTTPS - "traefik.http.routers.{{INSTANCE_NAME}}-http.rule=Host(`{{INSTANCE_NAME}}.{{BASE_HOSTNAME}}`)" - "traefik.http.routers.{{INSTANCE_NAME}}-http.entrypoints=http" - "traefik.http.routers.{{INSTANCE_NAME}}-http.middlewares={{INSTANCE_NAME}}-redirect" - "traefik.http.middlewares.{{INSTANCE_NAME}}-redirect.redirectscheme.scheme=https"
#----- routes for: odoo/web/database || odoo/website/info ----- - "traefik.http.routers.{{INSTANCE_NAME}}-db.rule=(Host(`{{INSTANCE_NAME}}.{{BASE_HOSTNAME}}`)) && (PathPrefix(`/web/database`) || PathPrefix(`/website/info`))" - "traefik.http.routers.{{INSTANCE_NAME}}-db.entrypoints=https" - "traefik.http.routers.{{INSTANCE_NAME}}-db.service={{INSTANCE_NAME}}-db" - "traefik.http.routers.{{INSTANCE_NAME}}-db.tls=true" - "traefik.http.services.{{INSTANCE_NAME}}-db.loadbalancer.server.port=8069" # db auth - "traefik.http.middlewares.{{INSTANCE_NAME}}-auth.basicauth.users={{BASIC_AUTH_USERS}}" - "traefik.http.routers.{{INSTANCE_NAME}}-db.middlewares={{INSTANCE_NAME}}-auth"
networks: proxy: external: true db_network: external: true
